about_the_game:
Product Introduction：

Does violence necessarily represent fear? Order, will there be selfishness? In the face of evil, should we uphold justice and break free from shackles, or should we carry the truth and never forget our original intention? "FLAM EVAW "is a spin off sequel to the real-life suspense romance interactive film game" Detective, Please Protect My Secrets ". You will continue to take on the role of community detective Maple Kurosawa, continuing the story from the end of this game. With your powerful detective and hacker skills, along with several female assistants with different styles, you will officially embark on the path of investigating against the Rainbow Criminal Organization.

 

Regarding this game:

"FLAM EVAW "is a spin off sequel to the real-life suspense romance interactive video game" Detective, Please Protect My Secrets ", with a comprehensive upgrade in story, gameplay, and features compared to this game.

In this adventure, you will continue to play the cynical community detective Maple Kurosawa, continuing the ending of the story and officially embarking on the path of investigating against the Rainbow Crime Organization. You will board this $1.2 billion super luxury cruise ship and embark on a unique adventure with several beautiful women of different styles.

The game contains 428 minutes of visual materials, 200+options, multiple independent branches of large-scale plots lasting over 40 minutes, a unique reasoning mode, 300 clue decks, over 10000 words of case text narration, pointing to 12 different exciting endings! Providing a standard/realistic dual difficulty mode, equipped with a movie quality package, all of these are good news for a suspenseful detective player!

At the same time, we have also prepared four different beauties with distinct styles, two old and two new! There are both highly popular clients who appear in this work and brand new characters with unique secrets in the new story waiting for you to unlock.

 

Role introduction:

Kitty, the beautiful assistant who is still by your side, has fixed the bug that cannot be explored in this plot

Kitty

The super popular character Wan Xiaoxiao in this work is coming to work at your agency this time!

Wan Xiaoxiao

New Character: Arrogant and Deadly Wanted Killer Aiko

Aiko

New Character: South Korean Foolish Police Officer Xu Yinzhen, Pure Love and Serious

Xu Yinzhen

There are other beautiful female characters waiting for detectives to unlock in the game!

 

Product Features:

1. The original team continues their adventure

As a spin off sequel to 'Detective, Please Keep My Secret', the production team will retain the original team! Authentic plot sequel! Familiar actors, more ups and downs in the plot, and unforgettable choices! Upgrade this first person adventure once again!

 

2. Gameplay upgrade hardcore reasoning

·The game has reached an epic level upgrade in gameplay! A brand new item exploration mode, clue card collection, character skill tree board (yes, you can operate your female companion to activate skills! There are also your exclusive skills!), and a super hardcore reasoning mode! Double the excitement of this adventure! All results depend on your reasoning!

·The plot tree will be upgraded again! Unique personal and peer investigation plot modes allow you to focus on your peers or newly acquainted female characters to explore their secrets! Or give up love and become a meticulous detective! Face the villain directly! Searching for the truth!

 

3. Powerful features and a brand new experience

·Male lead voice switch freely

In the game, we have prepared two versions of the male lead voice for players. You can choose the voice of Maple Kurosawa and switch seamlessly at any time, bringing players a different experience.

 

·Free choice of visual style

Similarly, we have also prepared two visual styles for players: 'Classic Movie Game' and 'Immersive Movie'. You can still freely switch and choose the listening effect you want.

 

·Two modes with different challenges

The "FLAM EVAW " adopts two difficulty modes: realistic mode and classic mode. You can choose the difficulty according to your preferences and embark on your own path of reasoning!

 

Follow us:

QQ Group ① Group: 182063329

We will regularly distribute welfare merchandise, organize everyone to vote, choose the storyline direction you want to continue, and choose your favorite character to return to the stage.

 

The developer's description of the content is as follows:

This game includes:

Mild violence: Beating scenes without bloodshed.

Realistic violence: bloodshed (shooting), violent behavior (beating, kidnapping), physical injury (implied by the camera, bloodless interrogation).

Suicide: including suicide plot (shooting oneself).

Criminal behavior: murder, assault, kidnapping.

Language: Mild indecent content, cursing.

Pornographic content: explicit clothing (swimsuits, bikinis), disguised nudity, including subtle sexual content (intense kisses, bed scenes), partial nudity.

Legitimate drugs: excessive alcohol consumption.

Adult venue: (bar)
